$comment: Single source of truth for tool metadata. Run scripts/generate-docs.ps1 after edits.

tools.name: OutlineCSharpFile
tools.readme_summary: Signatures of every type and member — no bodies. Best for "what's in this file?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: skeleton of a file: types and member signatures, no bodies. Best for navigation ("what's in this file?").
tools.llms_summary: signatures of every type and member, no bodies (70–95% reduction)
tools.capabilities_desc: Skeleton of a C# file — every type and member as a signature, no bodies. Best for navigation and discovery.

tools.name: FocusMethod
tools.readme_summary: Named method with full body + signatures of referenced members. `depth=1` includes private helpers.
tools.mcp_readme_description: emit the named method with full body plus signatures of referenced members. `depth=1` also includes bodies of private helper methods and properties accessed by the focus method. `minify=true` strips comments, `#region`/`#endregion` directives, and collapses whitespace. Pass the **class name** as `methodName` to target a constructor. On a `NOT FOUND`, the response hints where to look when the type is `partial` (a sibling file in the same namespace/folder) or has a base list (an inherited member).
tools.llms_summary: a named method with its body plus signatures of referenced members
tools.capabilities_desc: One method's full body plus the private helpers it calls (depth=1), including private properties. Exits the class once the target is found — no wasted tokens on the rest of the file.

tools.name: FocusMultipleMethods
tools.readme_summary: Same as above but multiple methods in one parse pass — deduplicates shared signatures.
tools.mcp_readme_description: same as `FocusMethod` but focuses on multiple methods in one parse pass. Class names (constructors) can be mixed with method names.
tools.capabilities_desc: Two or more methods in one call. The file is parsed once and shared signatures are deduplicated — cheaper than N separate focus calls.
tools.example_prompt: Look at ExecSql and ClearGrid in DataPage.cs

tools.name: FocusType
tools.readme_summary: Non-private members with full bodies, private members as signatures only.
tools.mcp_readme_description: emit a named type with non-private members shown as full bodies and private members as signatures only. Best for "explain class X" questions when the file has multiple types or private helpers dominate.
tools.llms_summary: non-private members with bodies, private members as signatures
tools.capabilities_desc: Non-private members with full bodies; private members as signatures only. Sits between Outline and Minify — right when you need the full contract but can skip private noise.
tools.example_prompt: What does FooService do? Show me its public API.

tools.name: FocusCallers
tools.readme_summary: All methods in a file that call a given method — focused view. Answers "what calls X?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: find all methods in a **single file** that call the named method and return them as a focused multi-method view. Answers "what calls X?" in one round-trip. For project-wide search, use `TraceCallers`.
tools.llms_summary: find what calls a method, in one file or across a project
tools.capabilities_desc: Finds every method that calls a given target and returns a focused view of all of them. Great for impact analysis before changing a signature.
tools.example_prompt: What calls BuildHeader? I'm about to change its return type.

tools.name: MinifyCSharpFile
tools.readme_summary: Lossless minify of an entire C# file — strips comments and whitespace, logic unchanged.
tools.mcp_readme_description: lossless minify of a whole C# file. Strips comments, `#region`/`#endregion` directives, and whitespace; logic preserved verbatim.
tools.llms_summary: lossless minify, auto-dispatched by file extension
tools.capabilities_desc: C#-specific minify using Roslyn's syntax tree — strips comments and XML docs, collapses whitespace, preserves every line of logic. Use when the AI needs the whole file but questions span multiple methods.
tools.example_prompt: Read OrderService.cs and explain how status transitions work.

tools.name: MinifyFile
tools.readme_summary: Auto-dispatch by extension. Covers C#, Razor, JS/TS, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, XML, C, C++, X++, VB.NET.
tools.mcp_readme_description: auto-dispatch by extension. Calls the Roslyn minifier for C#/Razor; falls back to basic minification for other types.
tools.capabilities_desc: Auto-dispatches by extension. Covers every supported language — JS/TS, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, XML, C, C++, and more. Falls back to lexical stripping for non-C# types.
tools.example_prompt: Read App.csproj — why is this package reference here?

tools.name: AliasCSharpFile
tools.readme_summary: Minify + rename private symbols to short codes (`M1`, `P1`...). Best on files with very long private names.
tools.mcp_readme_description: minify plus rename private symbols to short codes (`M1`, `P1`, `F1`...). Useful on files with very long private names.
tools.llms_summary: minify plus short aliases for long private symbol names
tools.capabilities_desc: C# only. Renames long private symbols to short codes (M1, P1, F1…) with a lookup ledger. Stacks with minify for extra savings on verbose repositories and mappers.
tools.example_prompt: Refactor CustomerRepository — it has 40 private helpers.

tools.name: TraceCallers
tools.readme_summary: Finds every `.cs` file across the project where `methodName` is called, and returns a focused view of each caller method. Answers "what calls X across the whole codebase?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: scans every `.cs` file in the project and returns focused views of all methods that call `methodName`, grouped by file. Answers "what calls X across the whole codebase?" in a single call. Uses name-based matching, same as `FocusCallers`.
tools.capabilities_desc: Project-wide caller search — scans every .cs file and returns focused views of all callers grouped by file. Right when you need the full blast radius before changing a method signature.
tools.example_prompt: What calls ProcessPayment anywhere in the project?

tools.name: TraceImplementors
tools.readme_summary: Finds every type that implements or extends a named interface/base across the project, and returns a focused type view for each. Answers "what implements IFoo?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: finds every type that implements or extends the named interface or base type, and returns a focused type view for each. Answers "what implements IFoo?" or "what extends BaseBar?" in a single call.
tools.llms_summary: find every type implementing an interface or extending a base type
tools.capabilities_desc: Scans the whole project and returns a focused type view for every class that implements an interface or extends a base type. Replaces grep + manual navigation.

tools.name: TraceDiRegistrations
tools.readme_summary: Finds every Dependency-Injection registration referencing a type (interface or concrete) and returns a compact table of `file:line`, method, `ServiceType -> ImplType`, and key. Answers "where is IFoo wired, and to what?"
tools.mcp_readme_description: finds every Dependency-Injection registration referencing a type (interface or concrete) and returns a compact table: `file:line`, method, `ServiceType -> ImplType`, and keyed key. Answers "where is IFoo wired, and to what implementation?" — the question a constructor caller-trace can't, since DI-built types are never `new`-ed.
tools.llms_summary: find where a type is registered in dependency injection and what it's wired to
tools.capabilities_desc: Finds every Dependency-Injection registration for a type and returns a compact table — file:line, lifetime, and service → implementation. Answers "where is this wired, and to what?", which a constructor search can't, since DI types are never newed.
tools.example_prompt: Where is IOrderRepository registered, and what's it wired to?

tools.name: MapProject
tools.readme_summary: Maps every type in the project to its `file:line`, kind, and base list — a compact index for locating a type when you don't know its file. Pass `nameFilter` to narrow. **Disabled by default** (an unfiltered map can be large); enable with the `TOKENSAVER_ENABLE_MAP_PROJECT=1` environment variable.
tools.mcp_readme_description: maps every type (class/struct/record/interface/enum) to its `file:line`, kind, and base list. A compact index for locating a type when you don't know its file; pass `nameFilter` to narrow on large repos.
tools.llms_summary: map every type in the project to its file, kind, and base type (a navigation index); disabled by default, enable with `TOKENSAVER_ENABLE_MAP_PROJECT=1`
tools.capabilities_desc: Maps every type in the project to its file:line, kind, and base list — a compact index for locating a type when you don't know its file. Pass a name filter to narrow on large repos. Disabled by default; set TOKENSAVER_ENABLE_MAP_PROJECT=1 to enable.
tools.example_prompt: Where is FooService? What types are in this project?
